description: This file defines the AssetResolver class in Drupal, responsible for managing asset libraries (CSS and JS), including dependency resolution, caching, and asset collection for rendering web pages.

classes.name: AssetResolver
classes.description: Implements asset library resolution, dependency management, and asset collection for CSS and JS in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AssetResolver with dependencies like library discovery, dependency resolver, module handler, theme manager, language manager, cache, and optional theme handler.

methods.name: getLibrariesToLoad
methods.description: Determines the list of asset libraries to load, considering dependencies, asset type, and already loaded libraries, ensuring consistent ordering.

methods.name: filterLibrariesByType
methods.description: Filters a list of libraries to include only those containing the specified asset type ('js' or 'css').

methods.name: getCssAssets
methods.description: Collects and returns CSS assets to be included, with caching and optional optimization.

methods.name: getJsSettingsAssets
methods.description: Gathers and merges JavaScript settings from libraries attached to the assets.

methods.name: getJsAssets
methods.description: Collects JavaScript assets, including header/footer scope, settings, and dependencies, with caching and optional optimization.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Static method to sort CSS and JS resources based on group and weight for optimal loading order.
